WITH user_orders AS (
    SELECT oi.user_id,
           MIN(oi.created_at)::date AS order_date,
           oi.order_id
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           order_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date, order_id) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT r1.user_id,
           (r2.order_date - r1.order_date) AS days_between
    FROM ranked_orders r1
    JOIN ranked_orders r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.rn = 1 AND r2.rn = 2
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = r1.user_id AND u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM pairs

WITH monthly_cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS total_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN u.id END) AS users_with_order
  FROM public.users u
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi 
    ON oi.user_id = u.id 
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at 
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
  WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(acquisition_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
  ROUND((users_with_order::double precision / total_users)::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM monthly_cohorts
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 1

        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time

    WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'

    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
order_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        a.user_id,
        a.order_time AS second_order_time,
        b.order_time AS third_order_time,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.order_time - a.order_time)) / 86400.0 AS days_between
    FROM ranked_orders a
    JOIN ranked_orders b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.rn = 2 AND b.rn = 3
)

ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_date,

    FROM user_orders

first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        a.user_id,
        a.order_date AS first_order,
        b.order_date AS second_order,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.order_date - a.order_date)) / 86400.0 AS days_between
    FROM ranked_orders a
    JOIN ranked_orders b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2
)

    SELECT order_id, user_id, created_at, sale_price
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

order_values AS (
    SELECT order_id,

           MIN(created_at) AS order_time,
           SUM(sale_price) AS order_value
    FROM non_cancelled_items
    GROUP BY order_id, user_id

ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, user_id, order_value,

    FROM order_values

first_orders AS (
    SELECT order_value FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn = 1

repeat_orders AS (
    SELECT order_value FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn > 1

SELECT 
    ROUND((SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM first_orders)::numeric, 2)

ranked_orders AS (

    FROM non_cancelled_orders

user_orders AS (

    FROM user_orders

        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
      AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
order_diffs AS (
    SELECT 
        a.user_id,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.order_time - a.order_time)) / 86400.0 AS days_between
    FROM ranked_orders a
    JOIN ranked_orders b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.rn = 2 AND b.rn = 3
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between)::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM order_diffs

WITH user_spend AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(sale_price) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend)::numeric, 2) AS p90_gross_spend
FROM user_spend

WITH organic_users AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE traffic_source = 'Organic' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM organic_users)
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled') > 0
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        a.user_id,
        a.order_time AS first_order,
        b.order_time AS second_order,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.order_time - a.order_time)) / 86400.0 AS days_between
    FROM ranked_orders a
    JOIN ranked_orders b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between)::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM first_second

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time,
        SUM(oi.sale_price) AS order_value
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        order_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time, order_id) AS rn
    FROM order_values
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((
        (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn = 1)
        - (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn > 1)
    )::numeric, 2) AS median_difference

WITH non_cancelled_items AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        created_at
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        MIN(created_at) AS order_time
    FROM non_cancelled_items
    GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
user_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        a.user_id,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.order_time - a.order_time)) / 86400.0 AS days_gap
    FROM ranked_orders a
    JOIN ranked_orders b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_gap)::numeric, 2) AS p95_days
FROM user_gaps

WITH search_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users 
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Search'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        a.user_id,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM b.order_time - a.order_time) AS days_gap
    FROM ranked_orders a
    JOIN ranked_orders b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_users,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_gap)::numeric, 0) AS median_days
FROM gaps
